desc: 石墨暗场大留白卖点，滑钮直饮与钢壁卷边逐镜拆解
leaf: 滑盖直饮双层保温咖啡随行杯
name: 滑钮直饮石墨暗场咖啡随行杯款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用纯白底直立全身像讲清杯型与滑钮盖轮廓。
主图一秒法则：仰拍推钮与饮口，一眼看懂不揭盖即可直饮。
以盖内同心密封圈与直饮通道的微距结构，替防漏主张做可视证明。
用杯口卷边与双层钢壁内壁的真实质感，坐实保温结构与饮用安全。
让买家把自己代入通勤路上随手递杯的日常，建立尺寸与握持手感。
收口促成，用双杯成组与空白按钮框承接组合购买决策。

style.backgroundSystem: one solid flat matte field per screen on a graphite studio system: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot, deep graphite #4A4E54 as the dominant benefit and rim-detail field, cool frost-grey #DFE4E7 for the lid-interior macro, one weathered clay masonry step in muted brick tone #A0655A for the single lifestyle frame only; never a gradient, never a horizon line, never a mixed or random environment
style.iconSystem: single-weight outlined glyphs and thin leader rules in #5C7C8D ending on empty label plates; no solid pictograms, no emoji, no star rows
style.lightingSystem: bright even cool studio lighting, front-left softbox key with a large fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows that always fall the same way, one slow skimming highlight sweeping across moulded lid edges on the dark screens, 5200K directional daylight on the single lifestyle frame
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium graphite studio drinkware visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep graphite field #4A4E54, seamless pure white #FFFFFF, cool frost-grey #DFE4E7 and one muted steel-teal accent #5C7C8D; cool tonality kept across every screen except one daylight lifestyle frame; one solid flat matte field per screen with no gradient, no horizon and no mixed environment; bright even cool studio lighting with a front-left softbox key, large fill card, soft same-direction contact shadows and one slow skimming highlight along moulded lid edges; modern geometric sans-serif reserved for post compositing while every rendered frame carries only blank rounded label plates, empty dimension bars and one empty button outline; single-weight thin leader rules in #5C7C8D and no solid pictograms; stable upright tapered tumbler at constant scale, lid married to the body, one claim per screen; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random or gradient backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting direction, no mismatched icon styles, no invented spec numbers, units, hours or percentages.
noDrift: no invented spec numbers, units, hours or percentages
style.presentationRules: upright tapered tumbler held at a constant scale and centred low in frame, lid always reads as one moulded piece married to the body, one clear claim per screen, macro screens shot along the part axis rather than floating the product
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweep on the studio screens; sunlit weathered brick masonry with soft mortar joints in the one lifestyle frame; no glossy mirror floor and no reflective table top
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif heavy display headline reserved for post compositing, upper 30-40% of the frame kept clear, every rendered frame carries only blank rounded label plates, empty dimension bars and one empty button outline
